module: Minimal auxiliary controller that animates the rotating elements of a light bar: as long as `electrics.values.lightbar` is greater than 0, it rotates an electrics value (angle in degrees, modulo 360); otherwise it resets it to 0.
notes: Jbeam keys read by init: `spinSpeed` (320 degrees per second by default) and `electricsName` ("beaconSpin" by default).
The code comment specifies that the value must return to 0 when the light bar is off, otherwise the projectors stay lit.
updateGFX reads `electrics.values.lightbar` without a nil test: the value must exist (otherwise comparison error).

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: advances the angle by dt × spinSpeed (modulo 360) if the light bar is active, otherwise sets the value to 0.

init.desc: Reads `spinSpeed` and `electricsName` and initializes the electrics value to 1.
